title: Refactor list and header views to render structured sections directly
description: Replace view-layer parsing/grouping helpers with direct rendering from `ShoppingListDocument`, including separate notes and meals sections, aisle ordering from the document, and summary counts from flattened aisle items.
acceptance_criteria: `ShoppingListDetailView` renders notes and meals as separate collapsible sections above aisle groups and iterates `document.aisles` directly in file order.
`ShoppingListHeaderView` reads structured notes and meals content rather than extracted markdown header text.
`ShoppingListsView` derives item and done counts from structured aisle entries rather than `ShoppingList.items`.

handoff_summary.completed:
All three acceptance criteria implemented and verified with a clean build:
1. ShoppingListDetailView.listContent now renders document.notes and document.meals as two separate ShoppingListHeaderView collapsible sections (above aisle groups), and already iterated document.aisles directly via filteredGroups.
2. ShoppingListHeaderView rewritten to accept label: String and lines: [String] instead of HeaderContent — no longer depends on ShoppingListHeaderExtractor or its markdown-parsing logic.
3. ShoppingListsView.loadEntries replaced ShoppingList(text).items with ShoppingListDocument(markdown:).aisles.flatMap(.items) for both itemCount and doneCount.
handoff_summary.risks: ShoppingListHeaderExtractor and HeaderContent remain in the codebase (used by their own tests). They are now dead code from the view layer's perspective but harmless. A future cleanup bead could remove them once tests are updated.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: ShoppingListHeaderExtractor.swift and its HeaderContent type are now unreferenced by any view but still present. No file-scope conflicts expected for downstream beads.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: ShoppingListHeaderView API changed from (content: HeaderContent, storageKey:) to (label: String, lines: [String], storageKey:) — simpler, typed, no text extraction. Notes and meals use distinct SceneStorage keys (.notes / .meals suffix) so their collapse states are independent. Notes lines are flattened from Block.lines and pre-filtered for blank lines before passing to the view. Meals lines are formatted as markdown bullets (\"- meal\") for consistent visual rendering.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: ShoppingListHeaderExtractorTests remain valid — the extractor itself is untouched. No view-layer tests existed for ShoppingListHeaderView so no test updates required for the API change.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: ShoppingListHeaderExtractor / HeaderContent are now view-layer dead code. They should be removed in a follow-up polish bead once their tests are updated or removed.

conflict_risks: ShoppingListHeaderExtractor.swift and its HeaderContent type are now unreferenced by any view but still present. No file-scope conflicts expected for downstream beads.

execution_history.summary: Refactored ShoppingListDetailView, ShoppingListHeaderView, and ShoppingListsView to render directly from ShoppingListDocument structure rather than through text-extraction helpers.
